pixel_proof.rectangle_policy: Before any material edit: below native top controls+8px, above original bottom HUD+8px, excluding actual reticle column+8px; no pixel-dependent region choice.

isolated_cpu_probe.scope: CPU-only static-SDL serialization/readback/free of two retained1080p inputs. No image writes, renderer, window, GPU, audio initialization, RSS or capture-latency claim. Input/order populations are small, not a general benchmark.

preserved_failure.cause: Initial owner expected the staged inventory unchanged but native correctly created its empty world lock. Original owner failure is retained; successor explicitly admits the lock without changing original inputs.

independent_actual_audit.scope: Independent retained-file revalidation and recomputed pixels/timers; no additional native/GPU execution.

limits: Scalar material edits only; encoded PNG import/decode/cook plus texture application is not qualified here.
